mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id, p.identifier, p.parent_project_id, p.project_name, p.description, p.start_date, p.end_date, c1.code_name AS status, c2.code_name AS is_public, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.created_by, u1.user_id AS pm_user_num, u1.user_name AS pm_user_id, u2.user_id AS pl_user_num, u2.user_name AS pl_user_id, p.editor_user_id, c3.code_name AS use_milestone FROM projects p JOIN common_code c1 ON p.status = c1.code_value JOIN common_code c2 ON p.is_public = c2.code_value JOIN common_code c3 ON p.use_milestone = c3.code_value JOIN users u1 ON p.pm_user_id = u1.user_id JOIN users u2 ON p.pl_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.insert: UPDATE projects SET project_name = #{projectName}, identifier = #{identifier}, description = #{description}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = SYSDATE, pl_user_id = #{plUserId}, use_milestone = #{useMilestone} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
INSERT INTO project_members(project_member_id, user_id, project_id, joined_at, is_active) VALUES(PROJECT_MEMBERS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{projectId}, SYSDATE, 'O1')
INSERT INTO project_member_roles(project_member_role_id, role_id, project_member_id, assigned_at) VALUES (PROJECT_MEMBERS_ROLE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{roleId}, #{projectMemberId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_member_id, pm.user_id, pm.project_id, pm.is_active, pmr.role_id, pmr.project_member_role_id, r.role_name, u.email, u.user_name FROM project_members pm JOIN project_member_roles pmr ON pm.project_member_id = pmr.project_member_id JOIN roles r ON pmr.role_id = r.role_id JOIN users u ON pm.user_id=u.user_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{id}
